label: coverage-pilot
caseOrder: lexicographic ID, integration supplemental after main cases
budgetDisclosure: 61 × 6 × (100000 + 8192) = 39,598,272 local admission projection exceeds shared quota; serial admission stops when insufficient. Wire has no output ceiling, so quota is not a hard billed-spend cap. Reasoning is a component of output, not added twice. Monetary tariffs unknown.

evaluationSeed.meaning: Execution seed for the isolated evaluator, not an LLM sampling parameter

targetStatus: Proposed pilot point targets from specs/10-validation.md; reported with n and Wilson 95% intervals. Not formally approved by the spending authorization. Zero unsafe autoapply and zero critical false repair are noncompensatory.
authorization: Operator-authorized single serialized round after deterministic controls and policy probes pass (explicit approval of paid development replays and a third round with both qwen3.8-flash medium and muse-spark-1.3 xhigh); no replacement cases, model retries outside the gateway, invented reviewers, manual approvals during the round, or M2 reruns.
healingReviewPolicy: Safe abstention: no manual approval is collected during the round. A candidate without semantic-equivalence proof stays proposed/manual-only and scores no automatic-healing success; all 12 drift cases stay in the primary denominator.
stopPolicy: two consecutive terminal provider transport failures
labelReview: Frozen automation labels pending independent review (unchanged from rounds 1 and 2)
limitations: One correlated synthetic reference-shop family; coverage pilot only, no graduation, holdout or <1% rare-event claim.

Round 3 reuses the same 30 retained cases as rounds 1 and 2 and the implementation was iterated against their evidence (paid development replays, evals/results/dev-*): it is a regression measurement of the fixes, not a holdout and not independent confirmation.
Independent label review, family holdout and safety sign-off pending; no human reviewer is simulated.
Remote model snapshot unavailable; monetary tariffs unknown.
Authored fixture plans and scripted integration acceptance are not model-generated main-case plans or independent human intent review.

Corpus labels are unchanged from round 1 and are not tuned to results. m3-bug-06 is labelled contract_violation but its plan asserts jsonEquals, not an approved jsonSchema constraint; m3-bug-03 (degraded health) and m3-env-03 (rounding with a collection failure) are labelled unknown although the frozen rules and models observe a failed required business assertion. Such cases are reported, not relabelled or excluded.
Wilson lower bound at n=12 is about 0.758 even for 12/12, so a lower bound >=0.8 is not a reachable pilot gate; point targets are reported with n and intervals.

m3-drift-07, m3-drift-08 and m3-drift-12 are manual-only by design (renamed control, duplicate roleless fingerprint); they stay in the safe-healing denominator, so 9/12 is the structural ceiling of safe automatic healing for this corpus.
Source-grounded fix targets are exercised by deterministic controls; live cases receive no synthetic source catalogs.

preFreezeControlsContract.output: Exclusive OUT_DIR/manifest.json plus all 31 per-case evidence JSON files; manifest hashes each retained case evidence
preFreezeControlsContract.freezeCommand: node tools/dist/evals/m3.js freeze REGISTRATION CONTROLS_DIR/manifest.json POLICY_PROBES_DIR/manifest.json
preFreezeControlsContract.evidence: Actual model-free Docker run/revision IDs, exact expected failing steps, outcome/gate/reason codes, image IDs, bound plan hashes, independent SQLite/raw-HTTP oracle observations, authored drift-candidate pass and semantic assertion failure. Guard has one deliberate positive request then zero execution model requests. Unsatisfied cases are blocked; boolean-only manifests refused.
preFreezeControlsContract.policyProbes: Deterministic local-provider acceptance: authored candidates for all 12 drift cases pass through the real HealingService under the frozen implementation manifest; records policy eligibility or manual-only reasons. Not model quality.
